item.title: 'I've sneezed about 17 times today': Allergy season rips across Sacramento in full force

item.title: Most Americans oppose ongoing US military action in Iran: Survey

item.title: CAL FIRE responds to vegetation fire near Colfax
item.description: (FOX40.COM) — CAL FIRE NEU responded to a vegetation fire near Colfax on Saturday. According to the agency, the fire started in the area of Interstate 80 and Highway 174. The fire burned about 1/10 of an acre. The cause of the fire is under investigation.
